question_answered_first.q: Is trust-ir's semantics written down anywhere, or only implicit in the compiler?
question_answered_first.a: Written down TWICE, and neither one is the compiler.

lean_semantics.kind: Lean 4 monadic small-step operational semantics; Semantics/Step.lean dispatches every Inst
lean_semantics.join_evidence: crates/trust-ir/tests/lean_schema_parity.rs header: 'There is no Lean toolchain in CI here to *prove* parity, but we CAN mechanically detect drift' and 'The gate matches constructor NAMES. It cannot see semantic depth.'

rust_reference_interpreter.self_description: 'Lean remains the source of truth for the full operational semantics'

question_answered_first.consequence: Agreement CANNOT be proved against trust-ir's semantics as it stands: the authoritative object (Lean) is joined to the shipped compiler by a name check, and the meaning of an emitted module in the shipped binary is fixed by to_mir.rs + LLVM. GAP 2 is therefore REDUCED and MEASURED, not closed.

executors.E1: Clean's ir_eval, discharged by the CLEAN KERNEL reducing an Eq.refl over the registered module
executors.E2: trust_ir::parser + trust_ir::interpret over the committed emitted body
executors.E3: the shipped compiled function, reached through to_mir + rustc passes + LLVM

chains.why_this_chain_matters: The emitted switch lists cases 0..9 and 11 -- there is NO case 10. SourceSystem::PVS reaches the DEFAULT EDGE, and only an exhaustive enumeration puts an input on it. CORRECTED 2026-08-20: this was also called the sharpest available test of ROUTING, which the measurement contradicts -- see corrections_2026_08_20.C2. It is the DULLEST of the three by discriminating power (2,880 value-preserving target permutations). The hole is still what puts a live input on the default edge; routing is pinned structurally instead.

chains.enum_model_note: Level carries payloads (Succ/Max/IMax/Param) elided by the harness. Sound ONLY because the body provably never reads them — enforced mechanically by ir_semdiff::payload_is_unread against the committed emitted text, not asserted.
chains.e3_absent_reason: Level::kind_ord is a PRIVATE fn (clean-kernel/src/level/mod.rs:598). Recorded as an absent leg, never re-implemented: a re-implementation would be a fourth transcription agreeing with itself.

results.cost_verdict_per_chain: CostVerdict::Uniform(0) on all three, compared against a per-chain declared expected_cost_offset of 0

coverage.note: Agreement on one body's instruction mix says nothing about the forms it never uses. Printed on every run; a test fails if this note is ever left claiming more than was measured.

list: assert has_cubical_layer(Cubical) = false — the Eq.refl obligations are genuinely EXECUTED
assert tag 0's answer at tag 2's value — the module does not ignore its argument
assert fuel_out at the measured threshold — the cost measurement is not vacuous
rewrite `extractfield u8 %2, 0` to `extractfield ptr %2, 1` — the payload guard refuses
assert a wrong answer on the DEFAULT edge (tag 10) — the default edge is pinned, not a black hole
perturb the harness step overhead by one -- values still agree and the offsets stay UNIFORM, and the chain must still go RED against the declared offset (the cost gate, added 2026-08-20)
move one measured row's Clean fuel threshold -- the cost verdict must become Divergent and the chain RED
route Clean's case 11 to bb12 and tag 10 to bb11 -- a value-preserving permutation the differential cannot see, which the structural routing pin must refuse
falsification.structural_guard: crystal_a3_default_edge_is_actually_reached fails if case 10 ever appears in the emitted switch, so a dense table cannot silently remove the differential's teeth.

tcb_delta.why: trust-ir's parser and interpreter only POSE questions the Clean kernel answers. FOR VALUES: a wrong E2 yields a spurious RED, never a spurious GREEN -- the kernel rejects the generated obligation. FOR COST this was NOT true as written and is corrected here: trust-ir's step count is not kernel-checked, and the harness overhead subtracted from it is a constant of this harness, so a wrong value shifts the reported offset with no rejection anywhere. That is why the offset is now pinned per chain (a shift goes RED) and why the overhead is independently counted from the harness's own emitted instructions. Both directions of cost error are therefore RED, but by construction of the gate, not by the kernel's refusal.
tcb_delta.demonstrated_not_asserted: Four harness bugs during construction (missing @ sigil; functy table sized 0 vs declared functy.470; one enum declared where the body mentions enum.175 AND enum.13; subject declared returning enum.175 when it returns enum.13) each surfaced as a loud RED with the Clean and shipped legs still answering correctly.
tcb_delta.cost_leg_scope: The value leg is kernel-adjudicated. The cost leg is instrument-adjudicated: Clean's fuel threshold IS kernel-measured (least accepted fuel, with fuel_out kernel-accepted one below), but trust-ir's step count is trust-ir's own report. Do not read the cost row as a kernel claim.

defect_found_in_trust_ir.what: trust_ir::parser::parse_module cannot read trust_ir's own printed output for a Rust def-path name
defect_found_in_trust_ir.detail: `fn @mode::CleanMode::has_cubical_layer` fails at the first ':' with `expected '('`; the print->parse round trip is NOT total over the names the producer emits
defect_found_in_trust_ir.workaround_here: the subject is renamed before parsing; the interpreter never reads the name
defect_found_in_trust_ir.significance: independent evidence for the wider programme's move away from the text artefact as the anchor

two_design_brief_worries_that_are_actual.switch_arm_order: trust_ir::interpret returns on the FIRST matching case; Clean's ir_case_find (eval_ir_state.rs:1173) is an IRList.rec testing the head before the IH — also first-match. The last-wins behaviour flagged in the brief is in the GATE's CFG parser (emitted_cfg_parse_clean.rs, a BTreeMap::insert), not in either semantics.
two_design_brief_worries_that_are_actual.exh_flag: trust_ir::interpret destructures Inst::Switch { .., .. } and drops `exhaustive`; Clean's ir_step binds `exh` and ignores it (eval_ir_machine.rs:929). Both are exh-insensitive, so there is no divergence for a text-anchored gate to be blind to.

what_this_is_not: A PROOF. It is a measured, fail-closed agreement over a fully enumerated input set on three bodies, covering 6 of 28 IRInst forms. Extensional agreement — equal values and equal step counts on every input of a domain — does not establish that the two encodings DENOTE the same function.

does_not_move.note: Measuring encoding agreement on three other bodies says nothing about the designated target's refusing gates, and must not be reported as moving them.

enum_declaration_cross_check.why: The trust-ir side has exactly one human-chosen modelling parameter: the enum declaration reconstituted per chain, because the crate-level dump references enum.13 without carrying an enum table.
enum_declaration_cross_check.pinned_against: data/crystal_enum_tag_pin.json, produced by a DIFFERENT lane (77e42993e) from the Rust source for a different purpose
enum_declaration_cross_check.also_fails_if: a pinned enum gains a non-positional discriminant, because the harness's implicit 0..N declaration would stop modelling it

corrections_2026_08_20.why: An adversarial review of the link-2a work found two claims in this record that the code did not support. Both are corrected in place rather than in a footnote, because both were load-bearing.

C1_cost_was_not_a_gate.was: results.cost_uniform_on_every_chain was published as a RESULT, and ir_semdiff/mod.rs claimed cost comparison sharpens the differential.
C1_cost_was_not_a_gate.measured: ChainReport::is_green() was `disagreed == 0 && insufficient == 0 && agreed > 0` and did not consult cost at all. cost_is_uniform() was called in exactly ONE place in the repository, inside an eprintln!. clean_threshold_is_tight() failing only appended a printed note. This record would have published cost_uniform_on_every_chain = true identically had every offset differed.
C1_cost_was_not_a_gate.now: is_green() requires CostVerdict::Uniform(expected_cost_offset). The verdict fails closed three ways: Unpriced (a row produced no cost datum -- the retired `cost_offsets.len() == 1` predicate called 1-of-12 uniform), Loose (a threshold accepted but never shown necessary), Divergent (offsets differ). The expectation is PINNED per chain, because a wrong harness overhead shifts every row equally and stays uniform.
falsified_by: crystal_a3_mutation_a_wrong_harness_overhead_turns_the_gate_red -- perturbs the MEASURED quantity (the subtracted harness overhead), values still agree, offsets stay uniform, chain goes RED against the pin
crystal_a3_mutation_a_single_divergent_row_turns_the_gate_red -- one real measured row's threshold moves, verdict becomes Divergent, chain goes RED
six report/cost unit tests covering Unpriced, Loose, Divergent, uniform-but-unpinned, and the pinned-uniform green
C1_cost_was_not_a_gate.still_true_and_stated: Uniformity alone cannot see a CONSTANT error. Two independent checks cover it: the subtracted overhead is counted from the harness's emitted instructions (crystal_a3_harness_step_overhead_is_derived_not_tuned), and the resulting offset is compared against a declared value. Neither alone suffices.

C2_from_source_system_is_the_dullest_cha.was: 'A non-contiguous case list with a hole is the sharpest available test of the one thing GAP 2 names by name', on the grounds that a contiguous table can be got right by a mechanism that merely indexes while a hole cannot.
C2_from_source_system_is_the_dullest_cha.measured: Six of the twelve target blocks (bb5 bb6 bb7 bb10 bb11 bb12) emit the same `const enum.13 { 4 }`. 2,880 permutations of the targets return identical values on all twelve inputs. The positional off-by-one the hole was meant to expose -- routing case 11 to bb12 and tag 10 to bb11 -- is observably wrong on 0 of 12 inputs, and both blocks are `const` + `br`, so the step count cannot separate them either.
C2_from_source_system_is_the_dullest_cha.mutation_that_was_cited_and_does_not_do_: crystal_a3_mutation_default_edge_answer_is_pinned refutes a wrong VALUE at tag 10. Every block tag 10 could plausibly reach -- bb10, bb11, bb12 -- answers 4, so it leaves a wrong ROUTE green.
C2_from_source_system_is_the_dullest_cha.now: Routing is pinned STRUCTURALLY: crystal_a3_routing_pairwise_matches_the_emitted_switch compares the registered Clean case table against the emitted switch tag-for-tag, target-for-target, default included, on all three chains. crystal_a3_mutation_a_value_preserving_route_swap_is_refused applies the swap and requires a refusal. crystal_a3_the_value_differential_is_blind_to_the_swap MEASURES the blindness rather than conceding it.
C2_from_source_system_is_the_dullest_cha.hole_still_worth_keeping: Yes -- it puts a live input on the DEFAULT edge, which only an exhaustive enumeration does, and crystal_a3_default_edge_is_actually_reached still fails if it closes. What changed is the claim made ABOUT it.

discriminating_power.metric: permutations of a switch's target blocks that leave the observed value function unchanged; 1 means every wrong routing is visible to a value differential, larger is the size of the blind spot
discriminating_power.computed_by: crystal_a3_discriminating_power_is_measured, from the committed fixtures, cross-checked against the value declared on each Chain
discriminating_power.finding: The only fully discriminating chain is the one with no E3, and the widest chain is the dullest. Stated rather than averaged away.
